inspected_frames.observation: Broad basal half-cardioid vanes, straight serial ribs and small knobbly axis read together, with vanes extending to base.
Third vane viewed edge-on between two broader faces; ribbing is retained on both sides.
Ribs grade from near transverse at base to oblique higher; no false fern branching.
Full vanes and rows remain readable; no external stem or disk.
Back-facing ribbed surfaces readable at lower contrast; no blank lamina replacing modules.
Exactly three equal radial vanes meet central nodular axis.
Real geometric rib relief and axis nodes visible without palette differences.
Stemless broad-base tapering form, without invented stalk or disc.

concept_comparison: Retain three broad vanes, knobbly core and stemless base. Reject the concept exaggerated standalone spherical knots, bowed ribs and unequal vane height. Actual model has three equal-length vanes, small staggered axial nodes and straight module paths with a graded attachment angle. All vane bases meet the axis.
known_limitations: Prospective correction of original planning stalk wording before freeze: Runnegar et al2024 finds no external stem continuation. Three equal-sized vanes around knobbly axis, basal vanes reach the axis; exact 3D dihedral spacing is artistic rather than a fossil cast. No appended holdfast or stalk.
Color, thickness and idealized proportions are artistic except explicitly source-bounded hard ranges; no original specimen cast claim.
CPU stills and Node parsing are not actual GPU or composed-scene acceptance.
